blocks.content: Recall the pure-drift approximation for the variance (Equation 18.8) and the within-line covariance across generations (Equation 18.9) for the design of a single selected line. Here we present corresponding expressions for the selection plus control and divergence selection designs (assuming there are no genotype × environmental interactions between lines). For unidirectional selection plus a control population [[SEE_FORMULA:18.28]]

Similarly, for divergent selection [[SEE_FORMULA:18.29]] Because each term in Equations 18.28 and 18.29 is independent, applying Equations 18.4 and 18.5 yields a pure-drift approximation for the variance in response in generation t of [[SEE_FORMULA:18.30a]] and the covariance between generations within the same line [[SEE_FORMULA:18.30b]]
